title: Colorectal Cancer Screening Tests
item_service_description:
<p><strong>A. &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;General</p></strong>
<p>Sections 1861(s)(2)(R) and 1861(pp) of the Social Security Act (the Act) and regulations at 42 CFR 410.37 authorize Medicare coverage for screening colorectal cancer tests under Medicare Part B. The statute and regulations authorize the Secretary to add other tests and procedures (and modifications to tests and procedures for colorectal cancer screening) as the Secretary finds appropriate based on consultation with appropriate organizations.</p>
cross_reference: Also see NCD for Fecal Occult Blood Test (§<a href="https://www.cms.gov/medicare-coverage-database/details/ncd-details.aspx?NCDId=167&ncdver=1">190.34</a>).
